import importlib.util, json, random
def load(n,p):
    s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(n,p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m); return m
g2=load("g2","/work/tmp/dev/gen2.py"); mn=load("m","/work/submission/main.py")
from collections import Counter
c=Counter()
for i in range(400):
    rng=random.Random(9000+i); doc=g2.gen(rng); r=mn.run(json.loads(json.dumps(doc)))
    s=r['summary']; m=r['metrics']
    c[s['coverage_status']]+=1
    if m['deduplicated_ping']: c['has_dedup']+=1
    if m['ignored_ack']: c['has_ign']+=1
    if m['late_ping']: c['has_late']+=1
    if m['capacity_drops']: c['has_cap']+=1
    if s['ambiguous_observed_classes']: c['has_amb']+=1
    if s['unique_observed_classes']: c['has_uniq']+=1
    if s['topology_paths']>0 and s['observed_classes']>0: c['has_evidence']+=1
print(c)
